name: AML Watcher
summary: Anti-money-laundering screening for sanctions, PEP and adverse media through a dashboard or API, with ongoing monitoring and a free trial.
best_for: fintechs, payment firms and compliance teams that need sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening through a dashboard or an API, from a small volume upward
skip_if: you want a published flat monthly price, a self-serve cancel button, or you screen so little that a set-up cost of $250 or more is not worth it
honest_knock: The recurring price is only visible after you set the search volume in the calculator, so we cannot give a monthly number. There is a one-time set-up cost on Basic and Premium, unused credits do not roll over, extra searches are billed at the end of the cycle, and cancelling means emailing sales.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-07 on amlwatcher.com/pricing) AML Watcher sells anti-money-laundering screening in three plans: Basic for quick checks, Premium for in-depth risk analysis and enhanced due diligence, and Enterprise for large organizations. The monthly or yearly amount is calculated by a slider for searches per month and entities monitored, and the page text we read does not show those amounts, so we do not quote a plan price. What the page does show is a one-time set-up cost of $250 for Basic and $1,000 for Premium, with Enterprise on a custom quote, and a saving of 17% for yearly billing. The minimum plan includes 100 monitored entities. A free trial gives the first five searches free. Extra searches above a package are charged at the end of the billing cycle at your agreed per-unit rate, unused credits do not roll over, and screening plus monitoring the same customer counts as one monitored entity in a month. Cancellation is done by emailing the sales team, and access continues to the end of the billing cycle.
